reading.passage: A new school year is starting, and I have made a plan for myself. This year, I will work harder than before. My biggest goal is to develop a good study habit, so I will read for thirty minutes every evening. I know it will be a real challenge, but I will stay positive and never give up. I will also learn to play the guitar, because I want to be more creative. My parents say success depends on hard work, not luck. I believe this is valuable advice. I will not waste my time. If I keep my plan, I think I will become a better person by the end of the year.
reading.passageCn: 新学年开始了，我为自己制订了一个计划。今年，我会比以前更努力。我最大的目标是养成良好的学习习惯，所以我每天晚上会读书三十分钟。我知道这会是一个真正的挑战，但我会保持乐观，绝不放弃。我还会学弹吉他，因为我想更有创造力。我父母说成功取决于努力，而不是运气。我认为这是宝贵的建议。我不会浪费时间。如果我坚持我的计划，我想到年底我会成为一个更好的人。

writing.prompt: Write about your plans and resolutions for this year. Use 'will' to talk about what you are going to do. Include a goal, how you will reach it, and a challenge you may face.
writing.promptCn: 写一写你今年的计划和决心。用 will 谈谈你将要做的事，包括一个目标、你将如何实现它，以及你可能面对的挑战。
writing.opener: A new year is starting, so I have made some plans for myself.
